overview.title: Overview
overview.welcomeBody: You are set up as a buyer. Post your first RFQ and verified Vietnamese manufacturers will quote within days — with payment protection, inspection and freight built in.
overview.subtitle: Here is where your sourcing stands today.

checklist.title: Get set up
checklist.description: Three steps to unlock the full marketplace.
checklist.profileHint: Suppliers quote faster when they know who they are dealing with.
checklist.kybHint: Required for Trade Assurance, escrow payments and financing.
checklist.kybPending: Your KYB file is under review.
checklist.rfqHint: We match it with verified factories automatically.

overview.noRfqs: You have not posted an RFQ yet.

saved.suppliersDescription: Factories you shortlisted while browsing the marketplace.
saved.productsDescription: Products you bookmarked for a future request.
saved.emptySuppliersHint: Browse verified manufacturers and save the ones you want to shortlist.
saved.emptyProductsHint: Save products from the catalogue and turn them into an RFQ in one click.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Your feedback builds the trust layer other buyers rely on.
reviews.pendingHint: Completed orders you have not reviewed yet.
reviews.noPending: No completed orders are waiting for a review.
reviews.noWritten: You have not written a review yet
reviews.noWrittenHint: After an order is completed you can rate the supplier on five dimensions.
reviews.newDescription: Rate the order honestly — other buyers use these scores to choose their factory.
reviews.chooseOrderHint: Only completed orders can be reviewed.
reviews.qualityHint: Did the goods match the approved sample and specification?
reviews.communicationHint: Response speed, clarity, English or Vietnamese support.
reviews.deliveryHint: Did they ship on the promised date?
reviews.reviewTitlePlaceholder: Sum it up in a few words
reviews.reviewBodyPlaceholder: What went well, what could be better, and would you order again?
reviews.noOrders: You have no completed orders to review yet.
reviews.submittedPublished: Thank you — your review is live on the supplier's profile and counts towards their rating.
reviews.submittedPending: Thank you — your review was submitted and is being checked by our moderation team.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.description: Third-party quality inspections booked through CANG's licensed partners.
inspections.emptyHint: Book an inspection from any active order to get independent eyes on the production line.
inspections.noChecklist: The partner has not published a checklist yet.
inspections.noReport: The report will appear here once the inspection is complete.
inspections.cancelDescription: The partner is notified. You can book a new inspection at any time.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Cases opened on your orders, mediated by the CANG resolution team.
disputes.emptyHint: If an order goes wrong, open a dispute from the order page — payments are frozen while we mediate.
disputes.replyPlaceholder: Add facts, dates or photos that help resolve the case…
disputes.closeDescription: Use this when you and the supplier agreed on a solution. The order resumes where it left off.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Every file attached to your RFQs, orders and compliance file.
documents.emptyHint: Files you attach to RFQs and orders are collected here.

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite colleagues and control what they can do on behalf of your company.
team.inviteDescription: They receive an email with a secure link. Roles can be changed later.
team.removeDescription: They lose access to your company workspace immediately.
team.revokeDescription: The link stops working right away.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Everything that happened on your RFQs, orders and payments.
notifications.emptyHint: We will let you know as soon as a supplier quotes or an order moves.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your personal account details and password.
settings.name: Full name
settings.emailHint: Contact support to change the email on your account.

company.title: Company profile
company.description: How suppliers see your company when you send an RFQ.
company.name: Company name
company.logoHint: Square PNG or JPG, at least 200 × 200 px.
company.taglinePlaceholder: e.g. Outdoor equipment brand for the DACH market
company.aboutPlaceholder: What you sell, which markets you serve, how you work with factories…
company.sourcingHint: Used to match you with the right factories and to prefill your RFQs.

verification.title: Verification & KYB
verification.description: Know-Your-Business checks unlock Trade Assurance, escrow payments and financing.
verification.whyBody: Verified buyers get faster quotations, access to escrow-protected payments and can be routed to financing partners. Your documents are visible only to our compliance team.
verification.pending: Your KYB file was submitted and is being reviewed. We usually respond within two business days.
verification.verified: Your company is verified. Nothing else to do.
verification.rejected: Your last submission was rejected. Fix the issues below and submit again.
verification.documentsHint: Clear scans or photos, PDF or image, up to 10 MB each. Visible to our compliance team only.
verification.ownersHint: Everyone who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of the company.
verification.ownerPepHint: Holds or held a prominent public function, or is a close associate of someone who does.
verification.declaration: I confirm the information and documents provided are accurate and that I am authorised to submit them.
